description: This file defines the interface for managing progress indicators, including functions for starting, stopping, and displaying progress, as well as external testing variables and functions.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays the throughput based on progress data and total amount.

methods.name: display_progress
methods.description: Displays current progress given the progress object and current count.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a progress indicator for a repository with a given title and total count.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a less detailed progress indicator for sparse updates.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts a progress indicator with a delayed start, for a repository, title, and total.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse, delayed progress indicator.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops the progress indicator and shows a message.

methods.name: void stop_progress(struct progress ** p_progress)
methods.description: Stops the current progress indicator, defaulting to a 'done' message.
